episodes.title: The Strongest Man
episodes.synopsis:
In the aftermath of the Sky Casino's fall, Kunikida is faced with a terrible choice. Ango, Atsushi, Lucy, and Kyouka dig deeper into the secrets hidden within Atsushi's memories, and Rampo proves his worth as the world's greatest detective.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: The Answer to Everything
episodes.synopsis:
As Fukuchi allies with plans to create an international anti-terrorist organization targeting Gifted, Atsushi and Rampo appeal to him for help. Rampo turns his immense detective abilities to the question of Kamui's identity, and the truth will change everything. 

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: HERO VS. CRIMINAL
episodes.synopsis:
Atsushi and Akutagawa find themselves cornered, with no choice but to fight Fukuchi and his seemingly insurmountable powers. Combining forces and trusting in one another, do they have what it takes to defeat the mightiest Hunting Dog?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: HERO WAR, GANG WAR
episodes.synopsis:
Loyalties continue to be tested as the depth of Fukuchi's betrayals become clearer. Tachihara is forced to make a choice between the Port Mafia and the Hunting Dogs, and he may be the only one left who can stop Fukuchi before it's too late.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: At the Port in the Sky (Part 1)

episodes.synopsis:
Fukuchi's plans and the Agency's attempts to thwart him escalate, and Aya comes face to face with Count Bram. Meanwhile, Nikolai and Sigma move to rescue Dazai and Fyodor from prison, but Nikolai has more than rescue on his mind...

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: At the Port in the Sky (Part 3)
episodes.synopsis:
As Atsushi races to find Teruko, Kenji arrives to help Aya and Bram escape the airport.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Land of Inhuman Demons (Part 1)
episodes.synopsis:
Kenji fights to help Atsushi, demonstrating why he is one of the most dangerous Agency members. Meanwhile, Dazai's machinations within the prison become clearer.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Land of Inhuman Demons (Part 2)
episodes.synopsis:

(Source: Crunchyroll)

(Source: Crunchyroll)
